_README: Material for an INDEPENDENT applicability judge. Contains only observable facts about each target and a neutral description of each technique. It deliberately contains NO applicability predicates, NO function output, and NO project documentation — if the judge can see how we decide, its agreement with us is meaningless.

uses_jwt: JWT library or bearer token reference
accepts_xml: XML parser in the dependency tree

accepts_xml: XML parser in the dependency tree

technique_definitions.name: Subdomain and endpoint discovery
technique_definitions.what_this_means: Mapping hosts, subdomains and endpoints before testing.

technique_definitions.name: Service and port discovery
technique_definitions.what_this_means: Identifying which network services are listening.

technique_definitions.name: Security misconfiguration review
technique_definitions.what_this_means: Checking for insecure configuration, missing security headers, default credentials, exposed debug modes.

technique_definitions.name: Authentication and session handling
technique_definitions.what_this_means: Testing login, session token issuance, logout, session fixation and account recovery.

technique_definitions.name: SQL injection
technique_definitions.what_this_means: Testing whether input reaches a SQL query unparameterised.

technique_definitions.name: NoSQL injection
technique_definitions.what_this_means: Testing whether input reaches a document-store query unparameterised.

technique_definitions.name: Reflected XSS
technique_definitions.what_this_means: Testing whether input is echoed into a response without encoding.

technique_definitions.name: Stored XSS
technique_definitions.what_this_means: Testing whether stored input is rendered without encoding for other users to see.

technique_definitions.name: Server-side request forgery
technique_definitions.what_this_means: Testing whether the server can be induced to issue requests to hosts the tester chooses.

technique_definitions.name: XML external entity processing
technique_definitions.what_this_means: Testing whether XML parsing resolves external entities.

technique_definitions.name: Cross-site request forgery
technique_definitions.what_this_means: Testing whether state-changing requests require an unforgeable token.

technique_definitions.name: Insecure direct object reference
technique_definitions.what_this_means: Testing whether one user can reach another user's objects by changing an identifier.

technique_definitions.name: Broken function-level authorization
technique_definitions.what_this_means: Testing whether a low-privilege user can invoke an administrative function.

technique_definitions.name: Unrestricted file upload
technique_definitions.what_this_means: Testing whether upload restrictions can be bypassed to place content the server will later execute or serve.

technique_definitions.name: Server-side template injection
technique_definitions.what_this_means: Testing whether input is compiled as a server-side template.

technique_definitions.name: Unsafe deserialization
technique_definitions.what_this_means: Testing whether untrusted data is deserialised into objects.

technique_definitions.name: JWT handling weaknesses
technique_definitions.what_this_means: Testing token handling: algorithm handling, signature validation, claim validation.

technique_definitions.name: CORS misconfiguration
technique_definitions.what_this_means: Testing whether cross-origin read access is permitted too widely.

technique_definitions.name: Race conditions
technique_definitions.what_this_means: Testing whether concurrent requests can interleave to bypass a check.

technique_definitions.name: Business logic flaws
technique_definitions.what_this_means: Testing whether the workflow's own rules can be violated.

technique_definitions.name: OS command injection
technique_definitions.what_this_means: Testing whether input reaches an OS command line.

technique_definitions.name: Remote code execution
technique_definitions.what_this_means: Testing whether code supplied by the tester can be executed by the server.

technique_definitions.name: Path traversal / arbitrary file read
technique_definitions.what_this_means: Testing whether a path can escape the intended directory.
